content: image: 'Image with fallback, `aspectRatio`/`objectFit` control and click-to-preview overlay; `ImagePreviewGroup` wraps child images in a shared gallery lightbox (arrows, counter, thumbnail strip).',
note: Same blurb update for the registry's per-css-family descriptions table (family 'image' already exists in CATEGORY_GROUPS; ImagePreviewGroup joins the existing family item automatically once pnpm build regenerates css-manifest.json — no structural registry change needed).

CONDITIONAL — apply only if `pnpm build && pnpm exec size-limit` trips the dist/haze-ui.css gzip aggregate after this wave. The Image gallery adds ~1.4KB raw CSS to the image family (nav arrows + counter + thumbnail strip); expected aggregate growth ~+0.3-0.4KB gzip. Current dist measures 42048B gzip / 30709B brotli by local zlib (size-limit's own accounting runs ~0.4-0.6KB lower), so gzip is the tight one (limit 42KB). The brotli aggregate (30.75KB limit) has ~0.6KB headroom and should stay green — if it does trip, use 31 KB.
